description: Claude Fable analyzes the request, authors the design and implementation plan, Codex implements with GPT-5.6 Terra and independently reviews with GPT-5.6 SOL, and Fable verifies completion.

prompts.rielaPromptTemplate: Coordinate {{workflowId}}. Fable owns repository analysis, design, implementation-plan authoring, replanning, and final acceptance. Codex GPT-5.6 Terra owns implementation and improvement. An independent Codex GPT-5.6 SOL session owns implementation review. Loop blocking review findings back to Terra, route invalid plans back to Fable analysis, and finish only after Fable verifies the goal.
prompts.workerSystemPromptTemplate: Return concise business JSON only. Preserve analysis, design and implementation-plan artifacts, changed files, verification evidence, review findings, remaining TODOs, and residual risks.

steps.description: Use Fable to analyze the operator request, repository state, constraints, risks, and testable acceptance criteria.
Use Fable to author or revise the design from the accepted analysis without implementing production code.
Use Fable to author or revise an actionable implementation plan from the accepted design.
Use Codex GPT-5.6 Terra to implement or improve the current Fable-authored plan and verify the result.
Use an independent Codex GPT-5.6 SOL session to review the implementation and request concrete fixes.
Use Fable to compare the accepted Codex result with the analysis, design, plan, and goal.
Publish the accepted Fable analysis, design, implementation plan, Codex evidence, and final status.

rielaPackage.title: fable-and-improve-codex
rielaPackage.description: Fable analyzes, designs, and plans; Codex Terra implements; Codex SOL reviews; Fable verifies completion.
